summary: Ran full backend pytest suite (28 tests) plus public-URL UI integration checks for session isolation, agent lifecycle, strategy editor, contest entry, rewards messaging, and mobile responsiveness.

critical.issue: Response omits `finances` key; requested contract expects `finances: null`.
critical.resolution: Added finances:null. Public assertion of explicit key existence passed in iteration3; contract test strengthened to require the key.

No server endpoint exists to delete test-created agents; long-running preview data can accumulate test records.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression fully green (28 passed). UI flow validated for create/start/pause/resume, strategy preset switching+save+draft restore, evaluate, contest join+re-entry lock, wallet honesty copy, and mobile overflow checks on /,/agent,/strategy,/leaderboard,/rewards,/guide. One contract gap remains: /api/rewards lacks `finances` key.
rca of the issue: Repro: GET /api/rewards. Observed payload does not include `finances`, while requirement expects `period_hours: null` and `finances: null`. Root cause: server rewards handler returns explicit keys but `finances` was not added. Mitigation: include `finances: None` in backend response model/object and re-run API contract tests.
